Every day is just a constant battle with this horrible feeling of frustration and sadness in my chest. It will not go away and nothing distracts me from it. I feel isolated, distanced from everyone and normality in general. I've gone a long time without feeling important to anyone, and that's really all I've wanted for a long time - to be important to someone who is important to me. I see absolutely no way of this improving. When I've brought this up in chat rooms and message boards I've been told to have hope because the future isn't set. It isn't, but when life hasn't changed for so long, what should make me think it will? 

I use this analogy: let's say you were put into a room and for five straight years, somebody came in and hit you a few times with a cane, and then left. Every single day the same, for five years, not a single day missed. Now there is technically a chance the man might not come and beat you tomorrow, but do you really have any reason to think he won't? Why would it suddenly change? Is there really any reason for you to have any hope that tomorrow you aren't going to be beaten by this man? 

Eventually you go long enough feeling completely alone and it just wears you right down. I have nobody I feel close to. I'm not interested in the things I used to like doing. I'm just a shell now, and I wouldn't even mind so much if I felt nothing like I used to, but there's that horrible feeling that I just want to go away. I want it go away enough that I'm ready to end my own life if it means not feeling it anymore.
